The examples' router carries example 287's two new notes
Countermodels of the pair of versions: five false proofs of agreement, reproduced and handed to the preservation stream
Countermodels of observed class initializers and of class files the tool read where a JVM reads another: three handed to the evidence stream, two refused
Every example's proof driver records identities, ends the run on a mutant that is not the replay's, and marks a trial
The evidence stream acknowledges inbox item I001
Example 289's four answers beside the route are accepted from the job that recorded what it ran, with no limit
Examples 286, 287, 288 and 290 are rerun at the frozen bound with drivers that record what they ran (verification pending)
The trace check makes a note, not an error, of a shared commit another stream's session stamped, while that stream's manifest lists the log
Record verification results for 1 job(s)

Merge the shared driver module, the pairing countermodels and the run-streams test fix into the preservation stream
The pair of versions compares exceptions by class and starts each version as if it ran alone (verification pending)
The checker models a line logged at WARNING as spring-jcl logs it, so example 287's preservation reaches both sides' bcrypt
Example 286's driver runs the protected-state tasks and records what it ran; where DataBinder.bind stops now (verification pending)
The router carries example 286's note on its protected-state driver
Models on request of ArrayDeque and HashSet take example 286's DataBinder.bind past its binding result, to the reflection
The state stream's line takes the evidence stream's trace-check fix for a shared commit another stream's session stamped
A write set, a first effect contract: prove --writes refutes the setter that writes a protected field and proves its honest twin

An effect contract at a call: a setter's checked write set stands in for its calls, and the application-level rename statement is proved through the honest setter and refuted through the adversarial one
Under --gaps assume, a gap whose object is of a class whose model the check runs is refused by name: the models on request no longer read fields no constructor wrote

A write set's frame holds on a declared exceptional exit and is of locations over inputs that may be one object: the challenge stream's three false frames are refuted or proved as JML's assignable states them

An effect contract stands in for a call only as it was proved: no final static an initializer computed, and object arguments of exactly their classes; the challenge stream's three callers are refuted or refused
The state line takes the observation binding, and the binding no longer takes a lambda's per-run name for a write: example 286's bind reaches CachedIntrospectionResults again; step 3's account chosen

Under --gaps assume, an object a JDK call is taken to return is of its declared class only where that class is final: HashSet.clone() and Date.clone() are no longer proved to return no HashSet and no Date
An effect contract's proof reads no final field of its receiver or arguments: the challenge stream's two callers through a caller-made final field are refused
The state line takes the evidence line's observation binding of mmnoqopr whole; the fix of the binding countermodels is left to the evidence line
An effect contract's stub meets the write gate: the challenge stream's proof by induction and empty write set through a contracted setter are refused

The state line takes the evidence line's observer of vqquvmnm whole: the binding countermodels are refused here too, and example 286's observation of CachedIntrospectionResults is refused before the run
A library method the own checker can't run may be replaced by a stand-in sampled against it on a JVM (prove --stand-in), and a result that used one says it rests on it
Example 286's binding runs through the bean wrapper by a stand-in sampled on 5.3.19, and the protected-state claim is refuted on 5.3.18 at its own bound in a probe (verification pending)
Example 286's someMap mismatch path gets past the exception and the property's type: a PropertyChangeEvent model on request, ClassUtils' class facts, and a second sampled stand-in
An observed initializer is observed with a relative --work, and example 286's protected-state tasks run again (verification pending)
Example 286's someMap mismatch path runs through the message codes: LinkedHashSet and StringJoiner models on request, String.lastIndexOf(int) and Class.isArray() of a class literal
Example 286's protected-state claim is refuted on 5.3.18 beside the route and accepted: binding Age writes the protected age
Example 286's someMap mismatch path runs to its end: a JDK exception keeps its message and cause, and the fixed task is proved over ASCII names in a probe (verification pending)
A check through a lemma states what the lemma's proof rested on: a stand-in, a model on request, an assumed gap or a contract
Example 286's adversarial fixture on 5.3.19: a setter that writes the protected flag is told from its honest twin, by its effect contract and through the binder (verification pending)
Example 286's fixed protected-state task runs through its permitted setters' effect contracts, and a write set frames a field of a type the check makes no object of by identity (verification pending)
Example 288's binding under its locales runs through the permitted setters' effect contracts in 286's form: kept on 6.1.14, refuted on 6.1.13 through Id under tr-TR (verification pending)
Example 286's fixed protected-state task: its one blocker on the real path recorded with its job and closure test, and a corrected formalization proposed to the user as a new claim file

test_accept.py's pipeline build step uses a path outside any home directory; the made-up one is proposed for the allow list

Countermodels of a loop invariant, found guarded; three modelled reads of an array a lemma made no refusal of, refused

The preservation stream acknowledges inbox items I006 to I009 and takes the two soundness ones next
Countermodels of the models on request under assumed gaps: three collections a gap makes, each proved empty where a JVM finds one element
Countermodels of a write set: a protected field written before a declared exception, and through one bean passed twice, each proved unchanged
Countermodels of an effect contract at a call: a final static set from a caller's setting, one bean passed twice, and a subclass argument, each a caller's property proved where a JVM breaks it
Countermodels of the acceptance check: seven controls accept.py accepts for an answer its evidence does not give
Countermodels of three rules that landed, and three wrong implementations the claims of 287, 307 and 286's protected state accept
Countermodels of an effect contract past its fix: a final field a caller's object was made with, read as if the proof's constructor had made it
Countermodels of the pair of versions past its fix: an exception's interface, message and own field, each proved to agree where a caller's handler tells the versions apart
Merge the challenge stream's countermodels of the logging model and of the pair's exceptions into the preservation stream
A logged record's getters may write its number fields and may not throw a Throwable, and the pair of versions tells apart two exception classes whose interfaces differ

Countermodels of the acceptance check past its fix: a step that goes on past the driver, a step before it, --work given twice and another checker binary, each accepted with no limit
Countermodels of an observed initializer's binding: a lambda replaced by another of its class, an object another class holds, and the default locale, each proved where a JVM says otherwise
Countermodels of an effect contract's stub inside a proof that limits writes: a proof by induction and an empty write set, each proved where a JVM writes what they rule out
Countermodels of what the pair of versions takes as the same code: a loop's ties and the identical-bytecode shortcut, each proved where a JVM tells the versions apart

Merge the default line and the challenge stream's tie countermodels; the code two versions are taken to share is closed against calls back through the JDK and takes in class initializers; 287 at bound 80, 289 and 290 rerun (verification pending)

307 has a driver on the route's slices, and the checker takes a call both versions share as one function of both: preservation verified and the mutant refuted in capped probes at the frozen bound (verification pending)

Countermodels of an observation bound to the settings it read: a property read under a JDK frame or through putIfAbsent, the environment by a looked-up handle, and three startup settings, each proved where a JVM under another setting says otherwise

Countermodels of the code two versions are taken to share past the reach's fix: an override removed, a hidden field, an interface's initializer two ways and the target's own class's, each taken as identical or tied where a JVM tells the versions apart
Merge the default line and the challenge stream's reach countermodels

The code two versions are taken to share resolves each field to the class that declares it and takes in the initializers the JVM runs; the observer's log path is absolute; 289 and 290 rerun (verification pending)

The checker takes bcrypt's crypt_raw as one function of both releases: a call on a receiver nothing reads after it, returning an array it makes; 287's preservation verifies in a capped probe at bound 80 (verification pending)
Countermodels of a stand-in a lemma's proof rested on, and of an Error a logged record's getter raises with no athrow, each proved with nothing stated where a JVM says otherwise

Countermodels of the code two versions are taken to share past the reach's second fix: a superclass, an interface and a default method's interface changed under identical code, each taken as identical or tied where a JVM tells the versions apart
Countermodels of a call taken as one function of both versions: cells a JDK method writes, a String's identity and an Error the JVM raises, each proved to agree where a JVM tells the versions apart
Countermodels of an exception's message kept from its constructor: a model of the JDK that throws the JDK's exception with another message, each proved to have none where a JVM gives the JDK's

State's last rules hold: a framed field of a type the check makes no object of, the LinkedHashSet and StringJoiner models, the PropertyChangeEvent model and the iterator, each probed with a property a JVM breaks and refused or refuted
Two wrong binders satisfy 286's proposed two-value protected-state claim: one that stops after the second suppressed value, and one that drops every value once one is denied

Merge the challenge stream's log, stand-in and supertype countermodels; a logged record's getter that can raise an Error, and a class whose header differs, are no longer taken as harmless or as the same code
Merge the default line's job results: 287's preservation established at bound 80 and accepted; 307's two tasks decided, refused by accept.py's entry check alone
288's preservation profiled: the binder's configuration and a last relational query hold the time, not the locale table; a call's record follows the objects a heap merge numbers again
Merge stream challenge of the domain-advances run into the line, while it keeps working
Merge stream state of the domain-advances run into the line
Merge accept.py's check of an overloaded target into the line
The preservation and challenge streams are told the default line holds the challenge and state merges
Merge the default line into the preservation line: 307's preservation accepted; its mutant control waits on accept.py reading a pair's harness
287's accepted preservation is agreement on terminating runs, and the preservation stream takes the user's order for the rest of the run
The call taken as one function of both versions refuses what its outcome leaves out, and --no-shared-callees turns it off (I023)
289's and 290's preservation answers rest on job 20261117-213024 and are accepted, by the user's D036
VF-041 to VF-043 from an outside review of the run's acceptance state; the low-hanging fixes go to their owners
accept.py reads a pair task's harness under pair-work/, and refuses a --work outside the step's folder (I015, first half)
Example 286's vulnerable protected-state task alone at the frozen bound, as one plain driver step (verification pending)

Merge 286's protected-state refutation, accepted from the clean rerun

Merge the default line into the preservation line: 307's two answers are accepted, by the user's D036

Merge the default line into the challenge stream's line, as the conductor's I006 asks
A call's record names an object, not the cells it returned: preservation's call-level rule proves a pair a JVM tells apart once the caller writes into the first call's array

Preservation's I023 fix holds for the seven, and --no-shared-callees takes no call; past it, a loop that keeps arrays of a constant length is an OutOfMemoryError the call's outcome leaves out, and the pair is proved to agree
Merge the challenge stream's record and allocation countermodels and close I028 and I029 in the one-function rule
